title: Effects of frame code
statement: Suppose the initial memory holds $0$ at the zero address, the value $2\cdot 4$ at the pool cell for offset $2\cdot 4$, and values $i$ and $j$ at the two argument addresses. For every natural number $F$, executing the frame code produces the memory obtained by first setting the frame pointer to the stack address for index $4$, then executing the code that zeros the first $F$ local stack cells, and finally setting the next two stack cells to $i$ and $j$, in that order.
hypotheses_covered: Initial zero cell contains the word value $0$
Initial pool cell for offset $2\cdot 4$ contains $2\cdot 4$
